reason: The submitted CIF is a valid explicit ordered realization: it parses and symmetry-expands in Fmm2 (No. 42) to 32 fully occupied atoms, Zn4Sn4Au8Se8S8 (Z=4), in the stated 7.877564 x 7.950365 x 11.243364 A cell; primitive reduction gives 8 atoms and exactly ZnSnAu2(SeS)2. The trace has strong indexing evidence (the best F-centered orthorhombic cell indexes all 18 low-angle lines with M18=47.3), and the instantiated final CIF independently reproduces the reported whole-profile Rwp of 4.20%. A free-reflection-amplitude fit on the same indexed reflections gives only a modestly lower 3.87%, so the atomic intensity model is close to the profile lower bound and no important separate reflection is left unexplained. Coordinates were refined from the ideal ordered model, reducing the profile residual, and the ordering search enumerated the 72 zincblende-derived assignments into four distinct classes: the selected symmetry-equivalent class is decisively best, while the nearest genuinely distinct ordering gives about 9.7-10.2% Rwp under comparable profile treatment; the rocksalt framework is much worse. Primitive/settings and symmetry-equivalent permutations therefore do not supply a distinct branch. Periodic neighbor shells are complete tetrahedral networks for every element, the minimum distance is 2.167 A with no overlap, all occupancies and stoichiometry are valid, and the formal charge assignment Zn2+/Sn4+/2Au+/4(chalcogen2-) is balanced. No concrete incompatible realization survives with comparable diffraction support.
